scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason: The required checkpoint cannot verify coffee, shipping, or prior bag totals from the confirmation.
scenarios.diagnosis: The automated check assumed that the confirmation would still provide the coffee, shipping, and earlier bag-total details needed for its comparison. Those details were only established earlier in the flow, so the check did not have the information it required at the end.
scenarios.suggestion: Update the test to save and compare the bag amounts before placing the order, then assert only the confirmation details the page is specified to show. If the product requirement truly requires the full coffee and shipping breakdown on confirmation, capture that page and file a product defect with the missing content.

scenarios.reason: The required pre-step interaction checkpoint could not be verified and ended the run.
scenarios.diagnosis: The automation expected a starting condition that it did not successfully verify, even though the storefront loaded and displayed the requested products.
scenarios.suggestion: Review the pre-step checkpoint and its expected initial-state conditions, then make it validate the loaded storefront before attempting the shopping steps.
